mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_message_outbox(event_id, order_id, topic, event_type, payload, deliver_at_epoch_ms) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{topic}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{deliverAt,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update: UPDATE order_message_outbox SET status='CANCELLED',lease_token=NULL,locked_until=NULL, last_error='购买任务已结束，取消未完成的建单命令' WHERE trace_id=#{trace} AND event_type='ORDER_BUILD' AND status IN ('PENDING','SENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, topic, event_type, payload, attempts, deliver_at_epoch_ms FROM order_message_outbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN event_type='ORDER_BUILD' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_message_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', lease_token = #{token}, locked_until = #{until}, attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE event_id = #{id} AND ( (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
